summary: Cartesia x Google Cloud Startups provides 12 months of Cartesia Startup Tier for Scale Tier members of the Google for Startups Cloud Program: 1.25M credits per month, up to five concurrent requests, including Pro Voice Cloning. This is distinct from the separate Cartesia Startups Grant. Cartesia pricing lists Startup at $49/month. The official program page links an application form at https://form.typeform.com/to/XVsY1DO3, headed “Welcome Google Startups!”. No application was submitted or award tested.
claim_steps: Be a Scale Tier member of the Google for Startups Cloud Program.
Open https://www.cartesia.ai/google-startups and use its embedded application form or official “Open the application form” link: https://form.typeform.com/to/XVsY1DO3.
Apply for this Google Cloud benefit, not the separate /startups grant; await approval.
